---
title: "brms companion: Bayesian versions of every model"
---

::: {.session-banner}
All models in the workshop are fitted with `metafor`. This page collects the equivalent **Bayesian** models in `brms` [@Burkner2017] in one place, using the same variable names as the lecture pages and activities. The code is not run when the site is built (each model takes one to several minutes to compile and sample). Install `brms` and `cmdstanr` as described in [Setup](../setup.qmd).
:::

```{r}
#| eval: false
# Load packages
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, metafor, brms, ape)

# Use the cmdstanr backend and 4 CPU cores
options(brms.backend = "cmdstanr", mc.cores = 4)
```

## Key translation rules

| metafor | brms |
|---|---|
| `rma.mv(yi, vi, ...)` | `yi \| se(sqrt(vi)) ~ ...` |
| `rma.mv(yi, V, ...)` (full matrix) | `yi ~ ... + fcor(V)`, `data2 = list(V = V)`, `prior(constant(1), class = "sigma")` |
| `random = ~ 1 \| study_ID` | `(1 \| study_ID)` |
| `~ 1 \| es_ID` (observation-level) | `(1 \| es_ID)` or `se(sqrt(vi), sigma = TRUE)` |
| `R = list(phylo = A)` | `(1 \| gr(phylo, cov = A))`, `data2 = list(A = A)` |
| `struct = "SPEXP", dist = ...` | `gp(x, y, cov = "exponential")` or `gr(site, cov = Sigma)` |
| `mods = ~ x` | `~ x` |
| location-scale (`scale = ~ x`, `struct = "DIAG"`) | `bf(y \| se(sqrt(vi), sigma = TRUE) ~ x + ..., sigma ~ x)` |
| `sigma2` (variances) | `sd_*` (standard deviations – square them!) |
| metafor scale coefficients model $\ln(\tau^2)$ | brms `sigma_*` coefficients model $\ln(\sigma)$ (= ½ × metafor) |

## Priors

Weakly informative priors on the effect-size scale are sensible defaults for lnRR, Zr and SMD:

```{r}
#| eval: false
priors <- c(
  brms::prior(normal(0, 1),         class = "Intercept"),  # overall mean
  brms::prior(normal(0, 1),         class = "b"),          # moderators (meta-regression only)
  brms::prior(student_t(3, 0, 0.5), class = "sd")          # all random-effect SDs
)
```

## Multilevel model (Activity 2, Model 1)

```{r}
#| eval: false
brm_m1 <- brms::brm(yi | se(sqrt(vi)) ~ 1 + (1 | study_ID) + (1 | es_ID),
                    data = contrast_es, prior = priors[-2, ],
                    chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, seed = 2026,
                    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
                    file = here::here("brms_fits", "brm_m1"))
summary(brm_m1)
```

## Shared controls + phylogeny (Activity 2, Model 2)

```{r}
#| eval: false
rownames(V) <- colnames(V) <- contrast_es$es_ID   # names must match the grouping levels

brm_m2 <- brms::brm(yi ~ 1 + (1 | study_ID) + (1 | es_ID) + (1 | species) +
                      (1 | gr(phylo, cov = A)) + fcor(V),
                    data = contrast_es, data2 = list(A = A, V = V),
                    prior = c(priors[-2, ], brms::prior(constant(1), class = "sigma")),
                    chains = 4, iter = 6000, warmup = 2000, seed = 2026,
                    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
                    file = here::here("brms_fits", "brm_m2"))

# Posterior I2 for each component

# 'Typical' sampling variance
w <- 1 / contrast_es$vi
v_typ <- (length(w) - 1) * sum(w) / (sum(w)^2 - sum(w^2))

# Posterior draws of the random-effect SDs, squared to give variances
post <- as.data.frame(brm_m2)
sds  <- post %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::starts_with("sd_"))
vars <- sds^2

# I2 for every posterior draw, then summarise (median and 95% credible interval)
I2 <- vars / (rowSums(vars) + v_typ) * 100
apply(I2, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
```

## Meta-regression and publication bias (Activity 3, Models 2–3)

```{r}
#| eval: false
brm_m3 <- brms::brm(yi ~ sex + log_mass_c + inv_sqrt_n + year_c +
                      (1 | study_ID) + (1 | es_ID) + (1 | species) +
                      (1 | gr(phylo, cov = A)) + fcor(V),
                    data = contrast_es, data2 = list(A = A, V = V),
                    prior = c(priors, brms::prior(constant(1), class = "sigma")),
                    chains = 4, iter = 6000, warmup = 2000, seed = 2026,
                    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
                    file = here::here("brms_fits", "brm_m3"))
brms::fixef(brm_m3)
brms::conditional_effects(brm_m3, effects = "sex")
```

## Meta-analysis of variability and location-scale models (Models 2–4)

```{r}
#| eval: false
# Model 2: lnCVR
brm_cvr <- brms::brm(lnCVR | se(sqrt(v_lnCVR)) ~ 1 + (1 | study_ID) + (1 | es_ID),
                     data = ce, prior = priors[-2, ], file = here::here("brms_fits", "brm_cvr"))

# Model 3: location-scale for lnRR (moderator in both parts)
brm_ls_lnRR <- brms::brm(brms::bf(lnRR | se(sqrt(v_lnRR), sigma = TRUE) ~ disp_mode + (1 | study_ID),
                                  sigma ~ disp_mode),
                         data = ce,
                         prior = c(brms::prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
                                   brms::prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b", dpar = "sigma"),
                                   brms::prior(student_t(3, 0, 0.5), class = "sd")),
                         file = here::here("brms_fits", "brm_ls_lnRR"))

# Model 4: location-scale for lnCVR
brm_ls_lnCVR <- update(brm_ls_lnRR,
                       formula. = brms::bf(lnCVR | se(sqrt(v_lnCVR), sigma = TRUE) ~ disp_mode + (1 | study_ID),
                                           sigma ~ disp_mode),
                       newdata = ce, file = here::here("brms_fits", "brm_ls_lnCVR"))

# Scale contrasts as multiplicative changes in heterogeneity SD
scale_coefs <- as.data.frame(brms::fixef(brm_ls_lnRR))
scale_coefs <- scale_coefs[startsWith(rownames(scale_coefs), "sigma_"), ]   # scale part only
exp(scale_coefs[, c("Estimate", "Q2.5", "Q97.5")])
```

## Spatial model

This uses `x_km` and `y_km`, which are calculated on the [phylogenetic and spatial](../advanced/phylo-spatial.qmd) page.

```{r}
#| eval: false
brm_sp <- brms::brm(brms::bf(ARR | se(sqrt(V_ARR), sigma = TRUE) ~ lat_c + (1 | study_ID) +
                               gp(x_km, y_km, cov = "exponential", scale = FALSE)),
                    data = arr_dat,
                    prior = c(brms::prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
                              brms::prior(student_t(3, 0, 0.5), class = "sd"),
                              brms::prior(student_t(3, 0, 0.5), class = "sdgp"),
                              brms::prior(lognormal(log(300), 1), class = "lscale")),
                    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99), file = here::here("brms_fits", "brm_sp"))
```

## Checking a Bayesian meta-analysis

```{r}
#| eval: false
summary(brm_m2)            # Rhat should be ~1.00; Bulk/Tail ESS > 400
plot(brm_m2)               # trace plots: well-mixed 'hairy caterpillars'
brms::pp_check(brm_m2, ndraws = 100)
brms::prior_summary(brm_m2)      # always report the priors used
```
